long:
Everyday stools from a private collection, imported from Indonesia. Simple and solid, they work as a seat, a side table or a bedside stool. Available in the store.

Each stool is carved from a single block of solid wood, so grain, tone and proportion vary slightly from piece to piece. Material to follow.
